C.B.I
Counsel for Applicant :- Atul Verma,Akhilendra Pratap Singh,Ayush Chaudhary,Rakesh Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Anurag Kumar Singh
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Rakesh Kumar Chaudhary, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Akhilendra Singh, holding brief of Sri Anurag Kumar Singh, the learned counsel for the respondent-C.B.I. and perused the record.
2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in R.C S.I 2021 S0001 SC N0- 952 of 2021, under Sections 120-B, 302, 201, 420, 506/34 I.P.C., registered at Police Station C.B.I SC1, New Delhi, District Lucknow.
3. Initially an F.I.R was lodged on 18.01.2021, stating that two decomposed dead bodies were lying in a pit.
4. On 17.02.2021, the C.B.I. has lodged a report against unknown persons, in furtherance of an order dated 08.02.2021 passed by this Court in Habeas Corpus Writ Petition No. 01 of 2021.

sentences.text:
In the order dated 05.01.2021 by this Court in Writ Petition No. 01 of 2021, it was recorded that in the petition,
the petitioner has pleaded:-
Sunil Kumar Nigam vs Union Of India Thru.

sentences.text:
C.B.I on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171941121/
1 "That, an incident took place on 22.12.2020 at 7.00 PM with the petitioner no.2 (corpus), the police of police station Chowk, Police Station Jaitpura, police station Pandeypur and Crime Branch of district Varanasi caught the petitioner no.2 and his friend namely Ravi Pandey near the house of Sunil Gupta.

That, the petitioner no.1 has been informed by the people of locality that his brother-petitioner no.2 has been taken away by the cops of the district Varanasi, but the police stations of district Varanasi are not given any information regarding the petitioner no.2.
That, the petitioner no.2 has been detained illegally by the police of district Varanasi against his wishes.
That, the illegal confinement of the petitioner no.2 shows his life is in danger; he may be killed in fake encounter by the police.

That it is submitted that the continued illegal confinement of the petitioner no.2 by respondents against his wishes in violation of his right and liberty guaranteed under Article 21 of the Constitution of India and he is entitled to a direction from this Hon'ble Court to be set at liberty forthwith."
5.
The C.B.I. has implicated the applicant claiming that he had been identified by a taxi driver in the police station on 18.01.2021.
The applicant has been taken in custody by the police on 19.01.2021.
The statement of the taxi driver has been recorded on 24.02.2021 wherein he inter-alia stated that four persons had traveled in his cab, one of them was carrying a bag in his hand.
They had stopped the car on the way on the pretext that they had to attended the natures call.

One person kept sitting in the car and three others went out and came back after 20-25 minutes and there was foul smell of decomposed dead bodies, when the persons returned.
6.

The learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that in para 50 of the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, the applicant's involvement in Case Crime No. 208 of 2016, under Sections 3/25 of Arms Act, Police Station Chetganj, District Varanasi has been disclosed, in which the applicant has already been granted bail.

7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, prima facie it appears that the driver had allegedly identified the applicant on 18.01.2021 whereas the applicant has been arrested on 19.01.2021; in the statement of the driver recorded on 24.02.2021, he has not mentioned the exact place where he had stopped the car and three persons had got down; keeping in view the aforesaid fact and coupled with the fact that there are 111 prosecution witnesses named in the charge-sheet and the trial is yet to commence and the applicant is languishing in jail since 20.01.2021 and without making any observations which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail.
